description: What the search looked for and where — the searches that came back empty as well as the ones that surfaced something. Each row carries the term, the match shapes tried (exact, fuzzy, phonetic, transliteration…), the classes and jurisdictions, the register office where one was named, and the outcome (no-hit | found | out-of-scope | screened-out | excluded-own-rights | negligible). This is the defensibility record: proof of where the search looked and found nothing. Filter by outcome.

runId.description: The run's full runId (slug-date-codename) OR just its codename.
